'''House Miurani''' was one of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] houses that operated during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] represented this house and was responsible for oversight of [[Zero Station]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

{{Chiss-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I pronounce you merit adoptive of House Miurani. My house.|Aristocra Saganu to Cipher Nine|<ref name="AotS" />}}
This family was mentioned in the dialogue options for the [[Imperial Agent]] class should they also be of the Chiss race. During the conversation, the Aristocra makes the player into a [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptive]] of House Miurani and represents the family in the galaxy.<ref name="AotS" />
